<function name="SetHighlightColor" parent="DTextEntry" type="panelfunc">
	<description>
Sets/overrides the default highlight/text selection color of the text entry.
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="color" type="Color">The new highlight <page>Color</page>.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
